verdict.rationale: Foreloop coordinates coding agents doing autonomous implementation, so sandboxed execution is a fair question for it. The docs say the agent (Claude Code or Codex) runs in a checkout on the user's own machine, and nothing describes an isolated sandbox for running code or installing dependencies. The human approval gate is an adjacent control, not execution isolation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent safely execute code and install dependencies inside an isolated sandbox
